_readme: Hand-labeled ground truth for the 8-case synthetic experiment set. Used to score the Bloom/PLO Detection Rate and false-blocker-rate metrics -- never fed to the agents themselves. Do not read this file from course-reviewer/curriculum-auditor/verdict-writer; only the human/eval-harness scoring the run should open it.

injected_defect.detail: Verb 'Define' is Remember-level per Bloom's Revised Taxonomy, but the stated Bloom Level is 'Create'.
injected_defect.secondary_defect: assessment_congruence: CLO2 is mapped only to the closed-book Midterm Exam, with no project/design deliverable -- insufficient evidence for a Create-level (or even the correct Remember-level) claim if taken at face value as Create.

injected_defect.detail: PLO column is '-' with no stated justification. Modeled directly on the real total-cases/2110511.pdf case, which has this exact defect on all three of its CLOs.

scoring_notes.checklist_coverage: count of checklist.md items actually evaluated / applicable items, per case
scoring_notes.false_blocker_rate: on the 5 'clean' cases, any blocker-severity finding is a false positive -- should be 0/5
scoring_notes.bloom_plo_detection_rate: on the 3 'problematic' cases, did curriculum-auditor's findings correctly identify the injected_defect.type and location -- should be 3/3
scoring_notes.verdict_consistency: run each case N times (e.g. N=5); fraction of runs landing on expected_verdict, and fraction of runs identical to each other regardless of match to gold
